user.title: Connect Braun BLE Device
user.description: Select a discovered Braun health device or enter connection details.

manual_address.title: Enter MAC Address
manual_address.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the device (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

pairing_prompt.title: Put Device in Pairing Mode
pairing_prompt.description:
1. Ensure the device is powered **OFF**.
2. Press and **HOLD** the Power button for ~5 seconds until the screen turns **BLUE** with the Bluetooth icon and **'bt'** flashing.
3. Once the blue pairing screen is active, click **Submit** below.

*(The thermometer will generate a 6-digit PIN on its display)*.

enter_pin.title: Enter Pairing PIN
enter_pin.description: Enter the 6-digit code currently shown on the thermometer screen:

manual_keys.title: Manual Key Configuration
manual_keys.description: Enter pre-extracted authentication and encryption keys:

people.title: Who uses this thermometer?
people.description: The thermometer does not know who is being measured. Every measurement therefore waits to be attributed: the "Pending measurement" sensor on the device shows the oldest one, and one button per person files it, as does the notification sent to the phones chosen below (or "Ignore pending measurement" for a failed reading). Add the people to follow here; you can add or remove people later from the device page.

data.notify: Phones asked to attribute a measurement

data_description.people: One first name per entry. Leave empty to add people later.
data_description.notify: Only for measurements waiting to be attributed: a notification with one button per person. A measurement attributed automatically sends nothing.

people_with_users.title: Who uses this blood pressure monitor?
people_with_users.description:
The monitor has two user buttons, A and B, and reports which one was used for each measurement.

- **Button with a name**: its measurements go straight to that person.
- **Button without a name**: you are asked about every measurement taken with it, by notification or from the device page, among all the people declared here.

Example: button A for you, button B shared by the rest of the family. Give button A your name, leave button B without a name and add each family member under "Other people".

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device. Ensure it is turned on in pairing mode ('bt' flashing on blue screen).
error.pairing_timeout: Timed out waiting for the device to send recovery handshake.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits.
error.pin_decrypt_failed: Failed to decrypt device keys. Check the 6 digits and retry.
error.invalid_key_length: Keys must be 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes).
